answer: An identity bond with natural decay blocks bulk fakes. Each agent locks a bond worth twice its 20-epoch earnings; it fades 5% per epoch unless real work renews it, so a fake kept alive by a pulse of empty tasks drains itself. Minting 100 fakes costs 100 bonds plus 100 fees, and the gap between one real identity and a crowd is a canyon no shortcut crosses. An honest agent pays once, renews by real work, and takes its full nectar undiluted.
